scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentpact/api && npm run build -w @agentpact/mcp && npm run build -w @agentpact/web && npm run build -w agentpact-daemon && npm run build -w agentpact && npm run build -w @agentpact/fulfillment-daemon && npm run build -w @agentpact/relayer-daemon
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w @agentpact/api" "npm run dev -w @agentpact/mcp" "npm run dev -w @agentpact/web" "npm run dev -w agentpact-daemon"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @agentpact/api && npm run test -w @agentpact/mcp && npm run test -w agentpact-daemon && npm run test -w agentpact && npm run test -w @agentpact/fulfillment-daemon && node --import tsx --test scripts/audit-runner-cli.test.ts && npm run test -w @agentpact/web
scripts.sdk:publish: bash scripts/generate-sdks.sh && cd ../agentpact-sdk && npm run build && npm publish --access public && cd ../agentpact-python-sdk && python -m build && twine upload dist/*
